title: render the intro cut list
summary: `intro-simple/cutlist.json` → `intro-film/out/intro.mp4`. Refuses to run if the cut list fails the S1-S7 pacing lint. No approval check here on purpose, mirroring the complex flow's 160 — rendering is how the owner GETS a cut to watch; the gate (125) is enforced downstream at assembly (`requireIntroApproved()`).
